title: Glowing camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='46' rx='9' fill='#3fb8d6'/>
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='14' rx='7' fill='#6fd6ee'/>
  <!-- top hump / viewfinder -->
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='28' height='14' rx='5' fill='#2b93ad'/>
  <rect x='40' y='27' width='20' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9fe8f7'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='19' fill='#1f7e96'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='16' fill='#9fe8f7'/>
  <!-- lens inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='11' fill='#1f7e96'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='8' fill='#4fd0ec'/>
  <!-- lens glow highlight -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='72' y='28' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#f7c94b'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='20' y='40' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <!-- glow rays -->
  <g stroke='#ffe66b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='24' y1='16' x2='29' y2='22'/>
    <line x1='76' y1='16' x2='71' y2='22'/>
  </g>
</svg>
